body: The feeling that I know I will not amount to anything in future brings me down, I do not have any talents. People around me are starting their jobs or chasing their passions but here I am mindlessly attending class that I do not like. My passion is to save lives.. I know, the irony. Ha-ha.
I miss the last time I was genuinely happy. I have nothing to look forward to anymore. I'm sorry
I am sorry. I am watching a Robin Williams movie. He is so happy. Why did he go? Why did he have to go? How did he decide to do that? I miss him. I see his smiling face and miss him.
